title: Half-parameter multichoose coefficient
statement: For every natural number $n$, the rising-factorial coefficient $\binom{1/2+n-1}{n}$, interpreted as the generalized binomial coefficient with parameter $1/2$, equals $\binom{2n}{n}/2^{2n}$.
